text.en:
Scoring <strand/>Strand Weapon Kills spawns <strand/>Threadlings upon reaching 100% Activation Progress.

Activation Progress gained and Threadling Count vary based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Minors: 34% Activation Progress | 1 Threadling
• Elites: 67% | 2
• Minibosses and Bosses: 100% | 3
